نستنقع (form X)
# نَسْتَنْقِعُ (nastanqiʕu) /nas.tan.qi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْقَعَ (istanqaʕa)
# نَسْتَنْقِعَ (nastanqiʕa) /nas.tan.qi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْقَعَ (istanqaʕa)
# نَسْتَنْقِعْ (nastanqiʕ) /nas.tan.qiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْقَعَ (istanqaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
